items.title: Equities end slightly lower as bond yields hold near multi-decade highs
items.summary: US stocks ended the session slightly lower on Tuesday, as government bond yields continued their ascent ahead of inflation and labor market ​data, while investors assessed comments from Federal Reserve officials for the path of interest rates.

items.title: Stocks drop and oil rises as Hormuz hopes fade
items.summary: HONG KONG — Asian stocks mostly fell and oil prices extended gains Tuesday as hopes for a reopening of the Strait of Hormuz fade amid expectations the Federal Reserve will hike interest rates again next month.

items.title: Gold holds near seven-week low, US economic data on tap
items.summary: Gold prices are holding steady near a seven-week low, despite ongoing concerns about rising interest rates from the Federal Reserve. Investors are treading carefully as they prepare for crucial US economic data, including employment and inflation reports, this week. items.title: US stocks: US market falls as higher oil prices, Treasury yields weigh
items.summary: US stocks declined on concerns over rising oil prices and higher Treasury yields affecting the market. Investors are cautious due to uncertainty surrounding a potential Iran war peace deal negotiations. Federal Reserve officials hinted at possible interest rate hikes if inflation continues to rise significantly. Nvidia shares surged after announcing a record $150 billion share buyback, while Tesla shares dropped after a lowered price target.

items.title: Gold, silver ETFs tumble up to 3.6%
items.summary: Gold and silver ETFs dropped by up to 3.6% on Monday as global precious metals markets reacted to inflation worries and anticipated US Federal Reserve interest rate hikes.

items.title: US Market: Fed's Hammack warns against inflation becoming entrenched in economy
items.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack warned that persistently high inflation could entrench elevated price expectations among US households and businesses. She said monetary policy may not yet be sufficiently restrictive, citing resilient demand, strong business investment and a stable labour market. Hammack also noted that rising US bond yields reflect higher real interest rates and a solid economic outlook.

items.title: Gold drops more than 2% on US rate-hike bets
items.summary: GOLD prices fell more than 2% on Monday as a rise in oil prices heightened inflation concerns and reinforced expectations of further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes.

items.title: Dollar firms as US-Iran tensions lift oil, hawkish Fed bets build
items.summary: The dollar showed strength as investors anticipated inflation data and central bank decisions this week. Oil prices increased due to ongoing US-Iran tensions, which raised concerns about energy supply. Analysts predict potential interest rate hikes from the Federal Reserve given current inflationary pressures. The Australian dollar is also expected to see a rate increase in a near-15-year high scenario.
